text_blocks.snippet: The Southwest Monsoon officially arrived in Kerala on June 4, 2026, three days later than its normal onset date. You can track current regional updates and daily bulletins directly via the India Meteorological Department.

list.snippet: Arrival in Kerala: June 4, 2026 (delayed from the usual June 1 start).
Advancement: Progressed across southern, eastern, and central parts of India—including Maharashtra and Mumbai—through mid-to-late June.
Current Status: As of mid-September 2026, active heavy rainfall systems continue to affect regions like the Northeast, West Bengal, and Saurashtra & Kutch.
El Niño Influence: The season progressed under the development of El Niño conditions, which can suppress overall rainfall totals.
Forecast Projections: Agencies like the IMD and Skymet initially projected a below-normal seasonal performance due to shifting Pacific and Indian Ocean patterns.
